section_2_ch_de_solar_alignment.note: DE realized solar not in inventory; using DE forecast file's forecast_solar_de_mw as best-available DE proxy.

section_3_de_forecast_semantics.assumed_semantics: No issue-date column present. Assumed: single-vintage day-ahead forecast at D-1 ~18:00 CET. Cannot be verified from file alone.
verifiable: two numeric forecast columns (wind & solar MW)
section_3_de_forecast_semantics.unverifiable_assumption: Whether values are stamped at issue-time or are post-hoc revisions. If post-hoc, that is leakage.
section_3_de_forecast_semantics.interpretation: Best-lag close to 0 with high corr is consistent with realization-stamped data (leakage risk). Forecasts typically show small positive/negative lag depending on longitudinal solar geometry and forecast bias. CH and DE differ by ~1 deg longitude (~4 minutes solar time), so realization-vs-realization peak should be at lag 0; forecast-vs-realization peak should ideally be at lag 0 too if forecasts are well calibrated for the same timestamps.

de_forecast_values_after_vintage.interpretation: Post-vintage rows are EXPECTED for a forecast (delivers forward). Leakage emerges only if rows were written AFTER vintage with realization-aware revisions. Without an as_of column this is unprovable.

leakage_trap_example.scenario:
At vintage v=2024-12-31 17:00 UTC we want feature `solar_pen_2025_01` for shape correction of Jan-2025 monthly intraday template. Naive code:
    df = read_parquet('entso_15min.parquet')
    feat = df.loc['2025-01']['solar_mw'].mean() / df.loc['2025-01']['load_mw'].mean()
This pulls REALIZED Jan-2025 values into a 'predicted-at-v' regression — leakage.
leakage_trap_example.guard:
1. ALWAYS filter: `df = df[df.index < v]` BEFORE feature aggregation.
2. For forward delivery months, substitute realized with either:
   (a) climatology = mean of same-month feature over prior years (<v),
   (b) DE forecast IFF provenance proves it was published <= v,
   (c) trend extrapolation from <v history.
3. Add unit-test asserting feature.max_input_ts < v for all training rows.

section_6_collinearity.recommendation: If total_re_pen vs (solar_pen+wind_pen) is highly collinear, use one only. Trend (t_idx) vs solar_pen also commonly correlated; include a centered time term and drop one of the penetration features.

best_feature.choice: CH solar_pen_m as PRIMARY; DE solar forecast as forward-only proxy.
best_feature.why: CH solar drives CH price shape; wind penetration in CH is small/noisy and is collinear with total_re; total_re alone hides hydro substitution dynamics.

temporal_granularity.choice: per-month aggregation for the shape correction layer; per-hour for intraday template.
temporal_granularity.why: Matches HPFC monthly granularity, dampens DST/holiday noise, and reduces variance for a regression with limited (~36–48) monthly samples.

forecast_strategy.choice: For forward delivery months: climatology (3-yr same-month CH solar_pen_m) + a small adjustment from DE day-ahead forecast aggregated to month, ONLY if its provenance can be locked. Otherwise pure climatology + linear trend extrapolated from <v history.
forecast_strategy.fallback: Pure climatology + trend, no DE forecast injection.

section_8_recommendation.rationale_go: Schema clean, no >24h NaN runs in key CH columns, CH-DE solar hourly corr 2024=0.931996077643335, 2025=0.9422589726476488. Leakage is manageable IF: (a) all training-time aggregations are pre-vintage filtered, (b) forward months are populated via climatology/forecast not realization, (c) DE forecast use is gated until an as_of column is added.
data_gaps: DE forecast file lacks as_of/horizon column.
DE realized solar absent from inventory; ingestion would strengthen CH-DE coupling estimate.
Hydro reservoir is weekly; needs explicit monthly alignment rule.
